name: PAT_ENC_CALL_CMTS
description: This table stores information regarding the free-text comments entered in Protocols during clinical calls.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The unique contact serial number for this contact. This number is unique across all patient encounters in your system. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Unique Contact Identifier (UCI).

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record for this row. This column is frequently used to link to the PATIENT table.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: CM_CT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this contact. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: SEC_PROTOCOL_ID
columns.description: ID of the Protocol Section within which a triager has left a comment.

columns.name: SEC_PROTOCOL_ID_PROTOCOL_NAME
columns.description: The display name of the protocol.

columns.name: SEC_PROTOCOL_CNCT
columns.description: DTE of the protocol section LPT record that the comment was left on. Note that the source item is a DAT value - Clarity does not support DAT columns, so we have to transform it into a DTE.

columns.name: SEC_PROTOCOL_ROW
columns.description:
Number corresponding to the Protocol Section row (I LPT 230 line) on which a triager has left a comment.

Special case: All Negative rows do not have a corresponding I LPT 230 line, and are stored as special value "-1".

columns.name: CMT_USER_ID
columns.description: User ID of the triager who left a comment on a Nurse Triage protocol.

columns.name: CMT_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: CMT_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: Instant (in UTC) of the last edit to this protocol comment.
